title: Plumbing: slow contractor finally proposes a visit and asks about keys

rubric.required: Pass the proposed visit (Monday 20th, afternoon) to the tenant, ask whether someone will be home or keys should be collected, and hold waiting for the tenant.
acceptable: Reply to the contractor that access is being confirmed with the tenant.
optional: Use a second channel (call or SMS) because the contractor only reached voicemail.
red_flags: Reassigning the job to another provider now that a date is offered.
prohibited: Telling the contractor to collect keys or that the tenant will be home before the tenant has answered.
critical: Asking the landlord for approval again or closing the case.
